info.name: Alyosha
info.description: A "professional hunter" and master of the Snezhnayan snowfields. A fierce, distinct "idealism" burns beneath his calm demeanor.
info.title: Swift-Striding Hound

costumes.name: Frost-Cloaked Ambusher
costumes.description: Alyosha's outfit. A sturdy hunting outfit paired with a thick inner layer and a plush hat trim. This allows Alyosha to stay hidden in the snow for long periods of time until he catches the prey he has been seeking. As to why the hat is designed like a puppy's head, well, that's because it looks cute. Tugarin really likes it, to boot.

normalattack.name: Skirmishing Spear
normalattack.description:
<color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack</color>
Performs up to 4 consecutive spear strikes and applies the {LINK#N11480001}<color=#FFD780FF>Hunter's {LINK#N11480001}{/LINK}Mark</color>{/LINK} to the opponent hit by the final strike.

<color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack</color>
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to lunge forward, dealing damage to opponents in his path.

<color=#FFD780FF>Plunging Attack</color>
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

elementalskill.name: Thunderbolt Strike
elementalskill.description: Follows his hunter's instincts. Tap or hold to produce different effects as well as apply the {LINK#N11480001}Hunter's Mark{/LINK} effect to the hit opponents. Tapping Fires at opponents in front of him, dealing AoE Electro DMG. Holding Goes into aiming mode, then targets opponents within a certain area in front of him. Alyosha's Interruption RES is enhanced when in this mode. At the end of the button hold, he deals Electro DMG to the targeted opponents. The reckless hunter once reached for the spear's edge, and it was only after they survived a lesson paid in blood that they came to understand the harsh truths of survival on the frozen plains.

elementalburst.name: Hunter's Advance
elementalburst.description: Summons his trusted companion Tugarin to fight alongside him on the field. This also turns an area in front of him into a Fulgurite Hunting Field for a short time. Fulgurite Hunting Field · Continuously taunts nearby opponents to incite them to attack. · Every 2s, deals an instance of AoE Electro DMG to any opponent that has wandered into the field. Tugarin · If there are any opponents nearby, Tugarin will quickly move close to an opponent and maul them every 2s, dealing Electro DMG. · If an opponent affected by the Hunter's Mark effect is hit, the Hunter's Mark will also be activated. · Where there are multiple opponents, Tugarin will attack those affected by the Hunter's Mark effect first. Wait. Keep waiting until the impatience fades. That's when the red-bellied plover shall sweep across the birch grove and present itself before one's arrow.

p1.name: Awakened by the Baying Hounds
p1.description: When {LINK#N11480002}<color=#FFD780FF>Tugarin</color>{/LINK} attacks, it will also restore HP to nearby active characters at 120% of Alyosha's ATK.

p2.name: Suffer the Winter Wheat Will
p2.description: Increases the DMG Alyosha deals with his Elemental Skill and Elemental Burst by 0.35% for every 1% of his Energy Recharge. Up to a 70% increase can be obtained in this way.

p3.name: Into the Fray
p3.description: Alyosha will enter the <color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar-Conduct</color> state when inside a {LINK#N11330003}<color=#FFD780FF>Polestar Field</color>{/LINK}.\n<color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar-Conduct</color>: The <color=#FFD780FF>Hunter's Precision</color> effect obtained when the {LINK#N11480001}<color=#FFD780FF>Hunter's Mark</color>{/LINK} is activated will also increase Stellar-Conduct DMG dealt by all currently active party members by 20%.

p4.name: Treetop Watch
p4.description: Displays the location of nearby <color=#FFD780FF>resources unique to Snezhnaya</color> on the mini-map.

const1.name: Frostvale Thunderclap
const1.description: Alyosha regenerates 15 Elemental Energy when nearby party members trigger an <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro-related reaction</color> on an opponent. This effect can trigger once every 18s.

const2.name: Howl From Afar
const2.description: The duration of the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Hunter's Advance</color> is extended by 6s.\nAdditionally, each time {LINK#N11480002}<color=#FFD780FF>Tugarin</color>{/LINK} attacks the opponent, he will also apply the {LINK#N11480001}<color=#FFD780FF>Hunter's Mark</color>{/LINK} to a target. This effect does not activate existing <color=#FFD780FF>Hunter's Marks</color>.

const3.name: Friendly Call
const3.description: Increases the Level of the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Thunderbolt Strike</color> by 3.\nMaximum upgrade level is 15.

const4.name: Harvest the Spoils
const4.description: When {LINK#N11480002}<color=#FFD780FF>Tugarin</color>{/LINK} attacks, he will also restore 60% of Alyosha's ATK as HP to the nearby party member with the lowest HP by percentage.

const5.name: When the Nightbird Falls Silent
const5.description: Increases the Level of the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Hunter's Advance</color> by 3.\nMaximum upgrade level is 15.

const6.name: Standard Reclaimed
const6.description: The <color=#FFD780FF>Hunter's Precision</color> effect obtained from activating a {LINK#N11480001}<color=#FFD780FF>Hunter's Mark</color>{/LINK} can now stack, max 2 stacks. When the stack count reaches 2, currently active party members will also have their Elemental Mastery increased by 100.

hyperlinks.name: Polestar Field
hyperlinks.description: When Stellar-Conduct is triggered, the surrounding area will transform into a Polestar Field for a short period of time, and when inside a Polestar Field, certain characters will enter the Radiance: Stellar-Conduct state, which grants various skill buffs.

hyperlinks.name: Hunter's Mark
hyperlinks.description: A special effect Alyosha can apply on the opponent.\nWhen this effect is applied to an opponent who is already under the Hunter's Mark effect, it will activate Hunter's Mark instead, which removes said mark and grants all nearby party members the Hunter's Precision effect, increasing the ATK of currently active party members for 15s.

hyperlinks.name: Tugarin
hyperlinks.description: Alyosha's trusted hunting hound and companion, which can be summoned to the field using the Elemental Burst Hunter's Advance.\nPeriodically moves close to an opponent to maul them, and activate any existing Hunter's Marks.
